set -eu
mkdir -p busco_db busco_runs
python3 -m zipfile -e "/jetstream2/scratch/main/jobs/78550083/inputs/dataset_8c0e2a96-ef92-4892-a640-78a0a65823b0.dat" busco_db
if [ ! -d busco_db/lineages/eukaryota_odb10 ]; then
  echo "Expected busco_db/lineages/eukaryota_odb10 after unpacking busco_downloads.zip" >&2
  find busco_db -maxdepth 3 -type d | sort >&2
  exit 2
fi
busco -i "/jetstream2/scratch/main/jobs/78550083/inputs/dataset_4d84675d-e8f9-4f59-8609-54e0802ef963.dat" -o Animals_Cele -m proteins -l eukaryota_odb10 --offline --download_path busco_db --cpu 4 --out_path busco_runs
cp busco_runs/Animals_Cele/run_eukaryota_odb10/full_table.tsv full_table_Animals_Cele.tsv
cp busco_runs/Animals_Cele/short_summary.specific.eukaryota_odb10.Animals_Cele.txt short_summary_Animals_Cele.txt
busco -i "/jetstream2/scratch/main/jobs/78550083/inputs/dataset_d44e2748-2746-4b0e-b569-23b7cb8e30da.dat" -o Animals_Ggal -m proteins -l eukaryota_odb10 --offline --download_path busco_db --cpu 4 --out_path busco_runs
cp busco_runs/Animals_Ggal/run_eukaryota_odb10/full_table.tsv full_table_Animals_Ggal.tsv
cp busco_runs/Animals_Ggal/short_summary.specific.eukaryota_odb10.Animals_Ggal.txt short_summary_Animals_Ggal.txt
busco -i "/jetstream2/scratch/main/jobs/78550083/inputs/dataset_07e64717-d9d4-4d2a-970d-0c38d0c9fb3f.dat" -o Fungi_Ncra -m proteins -l eukaryota_odb10 --offline --download_path busco_db --cpu 4 --out_path busco_runs
cp busco_runs/Fungi_Ncra/run_eukaryota_odb10/full_table.tsv full_table_Fungi_Ncra.tsv
cp busco_runs/Fungi_Ncra/short_summary.specific.eukaryota_odb10.Fungi_Ncra.txt short_summary_Fungi_Ncra.txt
busco -i "/jetstream2/scratch/main/jobs/78550083/inputs/dataset_0fd62599-5d0c-4c2e-a858-926793d75493.dat" -o Fungi_Scer -m proteins -l eukaryota_odb10 --offline --download_path busco_db --cpu 4 --out_path busco_runs
cp busco_runs/Fungi_Scer/run_eukaryota_odb10/full_table.tsv full_table_Fungi_Scer.tsv
cp busco_runs/Fungi_Scer/short_summary.specific.eukaryota_odb10.Fungi_Scer.txt short_summary_Fungi_Scer.txt
python3 <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
labels = ["Animals_Cele", "Animals_Ggal", "Fungi_Ncra", "Fungi_Scer"]
complete_sets = []
for label in labels:
    path = Path(f"full_table_{label}.tsv")
    ids = set()
    with path.open() as handle:
        for line in handle:
            if not line.strip() or line.startswith('#'):
                continue
            fields = line.rstrip('\n').split('\t')
            if len(fields) >= 2 and fields[1] == 'Complete':
                ids.add(fields[0])
    complete_sets.append(ids)
common = set.intersection(*complete_sets)
Path('answer.txt').write_text(str(len(common)) + '\n')
Path('common_complete_single_copy_buscos.txt').write_text('\n'.join(sorted(common)) + ('\n' if common else ''))
with Path('counts_by_proteome.tsv').open('w') as out:
    out.write('proteome\tcomplete_single_copy_buscos\n')
    for label, ids in zip(labels, complete_sets):
        out.write(f'{label}\t{len(ids)}\n')
    out.write(f'intersection_all_four\t{len(common)}\n')
PY
